title: Sales Development agent: connect to Salesforce CRM through the Salesforce MCP server
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, Salesforce permissions and actions, admin controls, and published Copilot Credit charges are supported. It distinguishes preview documentation from the roadmap rollout and does not mistake an organisation-wide access block for revoking the Salesforce connection.
